annotations.title: Accept a re-test quote and pay (x402)

description: Accept the quote from request_retest and pay the quoted total via x402 (USDC on Base) — paid automatically by your x402 MCP client. On settlement the re-test request is recorded (status paid, tx stored) and queued. Input: the exact service_name and quote_total_usd from your quote.

quote_total_usd.description: Total from the request_retest quote you are accepting

reason.description: Why a re-test is needed (stored with the request)

service_name.description: Exact service name, as listed by search_services (free)

name: accept_retest_quote
title: Accept a re-test quote and pay (x402)
